additional_info.body:
Dear Laurenz,
I am reaching out as Technical Expert for Sicharge D in regards of ticket
ID0447441.
Thank you for raising the ticket and highlighting these quality issues during commissioning.
I have though a few questions in regards of your query:
Could you clarify on which circuit breaker in the picture was the cable found loose. I can then report the quality issue to QM department.
Is this ticket referring to a recent commissioning, or an old one? I am asking this because I see on SCB that the charger (ChargerID:
uB5s3D
, SN:
Y2/T3314161484002
)  reports as date of dispenser commissioning the 28.05.2025.
Could you please clarify what do you refer to as "No plan available for download in the SCB? Are you referring to the Circuit Diagram? The circuit diagram is available on the SCB page of the charger:
https://configuration.sicharge.technology/chargers/uB5s3D/detail
Thank you in advance for the clarification and for reporting in a ticket such quality issues.
With kind regards,
